criteria_evaluations.name: Graph Predictive Improvement
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Macro F1 Delta: -0.0004 (Relative: -0.05%), High-Risk Recall Delta: -0.0046

criteria_evaluations.name: Number of Nodes
criteria_evaluations.evidence: 2,015 distinct GST taxpayers in benchmark universe

criteria_evaluations.name: Number of Edges
criteria_evaluations.evidence: 168,213 chronological B2B invoice edges over 24 months

criteria_evaluations.name: Edge-Type Diversity
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Primarily homogeneous B2B commercial invoice transactions and statutory GSTR return links

criteria_evaluations.name: Temporal Graph Snapshots
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Strict dynamic time-windowing G(T_k) required monthly to prevent leakage; full dynamic GNN adds high temporal maintenance complexity

criteria_evaluations.name: Graph Connectivity
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Zero-degree vendors in network: 99.65%. Modest density with core hubs and sparse periphery

criteria_evaluations.name: Number of Labeled Nodes
criteria_evaluations.evidence: 46,345 vendor-period ground-truth risk observation instances across 24 periods

criteria_evaluations.name: Graph Feature Importance
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Graph features represent 0.02% of total Tree SHAP attribution (0 features in Top 10, 1 in Top 20)

criteria_evaluations.name: Computational Feasibility
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Tabular+Graph XGBoost runs in <15ms inference on CPU. GNN requires PyTorch Geometric/DGL, GPU infrastructure, and sub-graph neighborhood sampling latency

criteria_evaluations.name: Incremental Information Beyond Tabular
criteria_evaluations.evidence: Tabular compliance and reconciliation features explain >99.9% of SHAP attribution. Graph metrics are heavily zero-inflated (>99.6% zeros)

rationale: The controlled 5-seed evaluation demonstrates that graph features provide neutral incremental predictive value (Macro F1 delta: -0.0004 across 5 seeds: 0.7404 Tabular vs 0.7400 Graph-Enhanced). Graph features account for only 0.02% of Tree SHAP attribution due to severe network sparsity (>99.6% zero values in graph metrics). Therefore, deploying a deep Graph Neural Network (GNN/GraphSAGE) is completely unjustified and would introduce substantial architectural complexity, GPU dependencies, and inference latency without measurable predictive benefit.
